schema_registry.description: Excellence section (Part B Section 1) — criterion-aligned drafting artifact
Impact section (Part B Section 2) — criterion-aligned drafting artifact
Implementation section (Part B Section 3) — criterion-aligned drafting artifact
Assembled Part B draft with cross-section consistency log
Evaluator-style review packet
Final proposal export
Phase 8 drafting and review status
Phase 8 checkpoint with gate results confirmation

Dev-graph snapshot: rebuildable index over Tier 3 records, source materials and document snapshots with content-derived identity; the before and after snapshot of every recorded change is also stored content-addressed under docs/tier4_orchestration_state/dev_graph/snapshots/<snapshot id hex>.json
Immutable document snapshot record written once by import_document; lifecycle state imported, draft, submitted or superseded

Document snapshot record as v1, plus: a source_grounded claim must carry a verified_span (plans/msca_dn_pre_evaluation_spec.md decision 17). v1 records are grandfathered; written by import_candidate or import_document with schema_id=v2
Evidence package manifest: inclusions with reasons, mandatory dependencies, exclusions with reasons, unresolved items, completeness and package hash, under one view policy and budget
Immutable evidence package items written beside their manifest by dev_graph_package_manifest_writer
Approved change record: record path, before and after snapshot ids and record versions, and the change set (nodes by id and version, edges by label including removals); written once by record_change
Content-addressed archive of a Tier 3 record version replaced by an approved change; the old version stays retrievable
Durable run records the impact planner reads: artifacts and checks with declared inputs, dependency edges and package; null inputs mean unknown coverage

Shadow impact planner advisory: affected records, passages, evidence, artifacts and checks with reason paths and one action each (rerun, reuse-under-policy, reconsider); newly relevant sources flagged; never consumed at runtime
Shadow comparison of a planner advisory against the reuse decision a run manifest recorded: one diagnostic (agreed, planner_narrower, planner_broader) with a row per node; never consumed at runtime

Tier 4 copy of a run manifest, written by tools/preserve_run_manifests.py. The file is named by runner.run_context.run_id_slug and carries the true run id inside. It holds node states, failure metadata, reuse decisions (null when the manifest holds no key), the reuse policy and the surviving run summary. The shadow comparison reads it by slug when a run id cannot address .claude/runs.

One scripted change scenario run in a sandbox: its contract, its arms with outcome, change set, contract verdict, advisory summary and shadow comparisons, and for an enacted scenario whether the replay reproduced the enacted snapshots; written by tools/run_demo_change_scenarios.py through runner.dev_graph.scenarios
Roll-up of every change scenario: record path, before snapshot id, enactment path when the world holds one, and per arm the outcome, verdict, advisory path and shadow diagnostics

A scenario recorded on the world itself: one change record per accepted arm with before and after snapshot ids and record versions, the advisory plan at its canonical path and what it asks of each reuse-eligible node; written once by runner.dev_graph.scenarios.enact_scenario

One dispatched run compared with every enacted arm's advisory: one shadow comparison or recorded refusal per arm, every planner_narrower row listed for investigation, and the recorded reason once there is one; written once per run id by runner.dev_graph.scenarios.record_rerun

Revision record: the contract, the check verdict (accepted, rejected naming the protected node, flagged_for_review) with change classes and unresolved items carried unresolved, and on acceptance the created candidate version with provenance (supersedes, change_id, evidence); written once by dev_graph_revision_record_writer

ESR intake record: availability declared from the closed set unknown, unavailable, not_applicable, available (never derived; a prior submission stays unknown), the bound submission and call identifiers, the document concerned, and the permitted purpose (blind_pre_evaluation or esr_informed_review); written once by record_esr_intake, read by the blind assessment lane
